name: Gasshuku ~Special Manager~
source:
Being the manager of the school's basketball club, during summer training camp the protagonist is asked by the captain of the team to keep an eye on Subaru and Mei as they practice.

The goal is for them to perform well in the match on the last day of camp, so they can become regular members of the team.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20050403054143/http://www21.tok2.com/home/chikage/gsm.html]official website[/url]]
